title: Spells catalog document
description: Shape of presets/<mode>/spells.json. Loaded by presets.loadSpells / getSpell. Storage: catalog document (array rows in one file).

id.description: Spell id referenced by classes.spells, mode auto families, etc. Player auto is mode-gated (not strategy spellPriority). Monsters use kit attacks[], not spell auto ids.

customUISprite.description: UI catalog id for the action-bar / spell icon (assets/sprites/<genre>/ui/). Designer: Select opens the UI catalog. Runtime falls back to customSprite then spell id.

kind.description: Combat kind (docs/09). AI and resolve treat heal/auto specially. support = utility/buff catalog rows (may be stub until systems exist).

stub.description: When true, spell is catalog-only / not wired for combat effect. Omit from class books until runtime exists (Phase E).

stubReason.description: Machine-readable reason the spell is a stub (e.g. no_light_model).

element.description: Damage/heal element for resist pipeline. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

powerCurve.description: Power curve id (docs/09). Empty = unset (omit on disk).

basePower.description: Curve base power (0 for pure autos). Scales strike mean damage.

damageAmplitude.description: Half-width fraction around strike mean (0.2 → min/max = mean×0.8 / mean×1.2). Omitted → 0 (fixed damage at mean). Autos ignore this field.

range.description: Chebyshev cast range in tiles. Far-use runes also apply the legacy Action box (Δx≤7, Δy≤5) when allowFarUse is true.

allowFarUse.description: Legacy far-use gate (Actions::canUseFar): require |Δx|≤7 and |Δy|≤5 in addition to Chebyshev ≤ range. Typical for player runes with allowFarUse(true).

level.description: Minimum character level required to cast (from spell_ref / Legacy rune:level when matched).

magicLevel.description: Minimum magic skill required to cast (Legacy rune:magicLevel). Runtime checks combatStats.magic (profile magicLevel normalizes to magic).

hitChance.description: Percent; default 100 in combat code if omitted.

requiresAmmo.description: When true, distance auto needs ammo (null ammo = infinite).

ammoPerShot.description: Ammo consumed on successful auto when requiresAmmo.

moveLock.description: Seconds of post-cast moveDelay (0 disables; omit uses Settings default).

cooldowns.description: Buckets: auto | primary | secondary | spell | item → key → duration seconds.

shape.description: Optional AoE / wave shape. Area uses type+code; wave uses type+spread+length. Designer: Select opens shape catalog with matrix preview (kernel/core/lib/shapes.js).

type.description: area = radial matrix by code; wave/beam = directed pattern by spread×length. Empty = unset.

code.description: Area effect code (int or legacy name string). Used when type=area.

length.description: Wave/beam length key (int or named custom key).

followupShapes.description: Extra dual-combat footprints after the primary shape (legacy Sweeping Takedown outer at 75%). Same cast center/facing; separate rolls per target.

shape.description: Secondary footprint (same type conventions as shape).

damageScale.description: Multiplier on post-mitigation damage for this pass (e.g. 0.75).

legacyName.description: Optional legacy display name for ports.

delaySec.description: Fuse seconds before shaped damage applies (e.g. divine grenade 3). Cast spends mana/CD immediately; detonation skips them.

delayPlaceRange.description: When delaySec>0: plant explosion center on primary if Chebyshev ≤ this (default 4), else under caster.

vocations.description: Allowed class vocations for this spell (relation: kind=classes).

source.description: Cast origin. source=rune spells are inventory-linked (runeItemId); mana is typically 0. Empty = unset (omit on disk).

rune.description: Legacy/display label for the rune (not used for inventory match).

runeItemId.description: Stackable equipment template id consumed when rune consumption is on (category rune in equipment.json).

field.description: Field kind deployed on the spell footprint (docs/26). fire/poison/energy = elemental hazards; barrier/vine = solid path obstacles (Phase K). Empty = unset (omit on disk).

deploysField.description: Alias of field for deploy path (creature kits use the same keys). Empty = unset (omit on disk).

fieldDurationSec.description: Override field lifetime in seconds (barrier default 20, vine 30; elemental kinds use docs/26 defaults when omitted).

destroysField.description: When true, cast clears an active elemental field on the target tile instead of deploying.

statusOnly.description: No meaningful direct damage (use min/max 0). Field deploy / conditions are the effect.

tauntDurationSec.description: On hit, force creature AI target to the caster for this many seconds (legacy challenge / doChallengeCreature). Default 6 when set via taunt flag patterns; omit when not a taunt spell.

forceMeleeDurationSec.description: On hit, force creature stand-off to melee (targetDistance=1) for this many seconds (legacy changeTargetDistance). Used by chivalrous_challenge and divine_dazzle.

chainOnlyRanged.description: When true with chain, only free (non-summon) hostiles with base targetDistance > 1 are hop-eligible (legacy chivalrous_challenge / divine_dazzle canChain).

chain.description: Multi-hop chain attack (legacy pickChainTargets). Number = maxTargets (total creatures hit, including primary). Object form allows hop distance (Chebyshev, default 3) and backtracking.

distance.description: Chebyshev hop radius between successive targets (legacy chainDistance; default 3).

backtracking.description: When true, pop hop stack and try other neighbors if tip is dead-end (legacy backtracking; default false).

condition.description: Condition applied to the defender on hit (haste / invisible / DoT). speedFormula: legacy ConditionSpeed target mina*(baseSpeed-40)+minb; engine stores delta (target-baseSpeed) as speedChange.

poolFormula.description: Resolved at apply time to poolRemaining/poolMax from the target's level, magic, and max mana (mana_shield). Empty = unset.

poolRemaining.description: Optional explicit mana_shield absorb remaining (catalog prefers poolFormula).

poolMax.description: Optional explicit mana_shield pool snapshot (catalog prefers poolFormula).

healthGain.description: HoT (regen): fixed HP restored each intervalSec for durationSec.

schedule.description: Optional fixed-tick stages (legacy addDamage rounds/interval/value). When present, ticks use stage.damage instead of the decaying-chunk model.

dispel.description: Condition kinds cleared on the defender when the cast hits (cure spells). Engine kinds: poison, fire, ice, energy, bleed, curse, holy, slow, haste, invisible, regen, mana_shield.

min.description: Fixed damage floor when set (overrides power curve). Field runes use 0.

max.description: Fixed damage ceiling when set (overrides power curve). Field runes use 0.

requiresTarget.description: Whether cast needs a primary target for center/aim.
